On Thu, Jul 1, 2026 at 11:05 AM soojin.lee@redwood.com wrote:
> I’ve attached our subprocessor export and our standard DPA + SCC package.

Team —

I reviewed Greenline's redlines. Key problem areas:
- Broad audit and inspection language (we cannot provide custom onsite audits; we provide SOC2 + penetration test summaries under NDA)
- Deletion and backup carveouts (their draft requires deletion across all backups within 7 days — operationally impractical)
- Subprocessor consent (they request prior written consent for every subprocessor; we operate with notification + objection window)

Mitigation proposal: accept SCCs and provide SOC2 attestation + an enhanced subprocessor notice timeline (30 days). For the audit ask, offer a scoped remote evidence package under NDA. To move quickly we should request an exception to Greenline's bespoke audit and deletion language and confirm SCCs as the lawful transfer mechanism.

I recommend we request an executive exception (legal + security signoff) to accept these mitigations for pilot customers. I have summarized redlines into a one-pager attached.

Attachment: redline_summary.docx

— Neha
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: marcus.lin@redwood.com
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-03T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + subprocessor disclosures — security input

Neha / Soojin —

Security notes for the exception request:
- Controls: Transit (TLS1.2+), Rest (AES-256), KMS-managed keys available; option for customer-managed keys for Dedicated.
- Subprocessors: majority are cloud providers (AWS, GCP), analytics vendors; list attached. None will perform profiling beyond processing requests.
- Audit: we can deliver SOC2 Type II (attached) and targeted pen-test summaries under NDA. No unlimited onsite audits.

Recommended risk treatment to present to execs: accept SCCs, provide SOC2 + evidence package, 30-day subprocessor notice, remote-only evidence for audits. If Greenline insists on in-region-only processing, propose Dedicated or hybrid solution (timelines + cost impact communicated).

Attachment: SOC2-2025.pdf

We need sign-off from Revenue leadership to offer any commercial concessions and from Risk for the exception. Please advise on the approver pool so I can prepare a short risk memo.

— Marcus
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
